# Curated print_usage declarations from tools/llama-bench/llama-bench.cpp
# fcac19079f3f2985fe74ed845f0880e7e9a8030a. Only declarations actually
# present in upstream bench are listed here.
-fitt, --fit-target <MiB>                 fit margin (default: off)
-fitc, --fit-ctx <n>                      minimum fit context (default: 0)
-m, --model <filename>                   model
-p, --n-prompt <n>                       prompt tokens
-n, --n-gen <n>                          generated tokens
-d, --n-depth <n>                        context depth
-b, --batch-size <n>                     logical batch
-ub, --ubatch-size <n>                   physical batch
-ctk, --cache-type-k <t>                 K cache
-ctv, --cache-type-v <t>                 V cache
-t, --threads <n>                        threads
-ngl, --n-gpu-layers <n>                 GPU layers
-ncmoe, --n-cpu-moe <n>                  MoE in CPU
-fa, --flash-attn <on|off|auto>           FA
-nopo, --no-op-offload <0|1>             offload operations
--repack <0|1>                           repacking
